The team note doesn't match the task. Neither option produces `'02-01-2026'` from `"2026-01-02"`: reversing the string gives `'20-10-6202'`, and swapping month and day gives `'2026-02-01'`. The code below follows the stated requirement and the example assertion.

```python
def change_date_format(date_str):
    year, month, day = date_str.split("-")
    return f"{day}-{month}-{year}"
```
